resources.string: The USB configuration or interface is unavailable. Exit the original projection app, unplug and reconnect the iPhone, then tap Retry. If this persists, the firmware may still own USB audio/HID.
Phase one: USB, H.264 / 30 fps, one screen. Microphone and vehicle integration disabled.
H6 wireless and voice uplink await phase two validation. Connect with USB.
Effective H6 video: H.264 / 30 fps. Saved video choices are retained.
H6 uses mobile audio routing and one media focus owner. Navigation overlays music.
Report saved in the app. Tap Share to export; it remains saved if no sharing app is available.

While parked, temporarily take over this iPhone’s USB audio, controls and network interfaces. Requires USB permission for the selected iPhone. USB audio and controls will pause; normal exit restores the original configuration. If the app is killed or the device changes, reconnect the cable. This applies to one connection attempt.
